audiences.title: Empowering Three Key Audiences
audiences.subtitle: Designed to provide clear, reliable, and accessible environmental intelligence.
audiences.citizensDesc: Real-time AQI in plain language, health guidance, live India map, city comparisons, and automated exceedance alerts.
audiences.researchersDesc: Multi-pollutant fingerprinting, persistence analysis, statistical anomaly detection, coverage gap audits, Excel & PDF exports.
audiences.adminsDesc: Three-tier governance structure (Super Admin, Central Admin, State Admin) with strict state scoping, sync monitoring, and audit logs.

aqi.healthDisclaimer: Health guidance provided is general scientific advisory. AIRWISE is not a medical service.

footer.aboutText: AIRWISE is an independent environmental intelligence platform built to make official Indian air-quality information transparent, accessible, and mathematically rigorous.
footer.sourcesText: Traceable CAAQMS feeds from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) and Open Government Data (data.gov.in).
footer.limitationsText: AIRWISE is not a government agency. Continuous monitoring data reflects official feeds published by CPCB and State PCBs.
footer.rights: All rights reserved. Dedicated to clean air and public awareness across India.
